basic_info.description: Great Inner Richmond location. One block to Golden Gate Park and Muni bus with easy access to Golden Gate Bridge. Close to both USF and UCSF. This offering is a 3BR-2BA unit in a 10 unit TIC Building. Completely remodeled kitchen which opens to the living room and dining area. All new kitchen appliances. Two full bathrooms also completely remodeled. Hardwood floors throughout, in unit laundry, and extra storage.  Extra Storage locker in basement. Upgraded building systems include: New electrical, seismic completed, and new sewer lateral. Common utilities include steam heat, water, sewer and garbage and are billed at $486.62 per month.
